name: grove
title_zh: macOS 日历与提醒事项的本地 MCP 管家
tagline_zh: 不用碰 iCloud 网页端，也不用授权第三方云服务。Grove 直接通过本地 MCP 工具读写你的 Apple …
tagline_en: Skip iCloud web and third-party clouds. Grove reads and writes Apple Calendar & Reminders via local MCP.
desc_en: Use Grove to read or manage Apple Calendar events and Reminders on macOS through its local MCP tools.
why_zh: 它把系统自带 App 变成可编程接口，让 AI 或脚本能直接增删改查日程和提醒，全程本地运行。
why_en: Turns built-in macOS apps into programmable endpoints—AI or scripts can CRUD events and reminders locally, with zero server relay.
limit_zh: 仅限 macOS，且需预先配置 Grove 的 MCP 服务器；只覆盖 Apple 日历和提醒事项。
limit_en: macOS only; requires pre-configuring Grove's MCP server. Covers Apple Calendar & Reminders exclusively—no Google Calendar, no cross-device sync.
title_en: Local MCP steward for macOS Calendar & Reminders
